definitions.explanation: A tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves. A fundamental nature word.
The material obtained from trees, used for building and crafts.

notes:
{木|き} is one of the most basic nature words, meaning both 'tree' (the living plant) and 'wood' (the material).

KANJI READINGS:
- き: native Japanese reading (kun'yomi)
- もく: Sino-Japanese reading (e.g., ⟦{木曜日|もくようび}→木曜日：00653_mokuyoubi⟧)
- ぼく: Sino-Japanese reading (e.g., ⟦{大木|たいぼく}→大木：04498_taiboku⟧)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {木|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant a tree
- {木|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a tree
- {木|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: under the tree
- {木|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make from wood
{木|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ず→見る：00283_miru⟧: 'Can't see the forest for the trees' - focusing on details while missing the big picture.
